answer_1.quote: Image captioning is one of the key visual-linguistic tasks that asks for generated captions with specific images.

answer_2.quote: Current image captioning models are evaluated by automatic metrics, which compute the similarity between generated captions and ground truth captions.

answer_4.quote: submissions of the challenge are evaluated by human judgments with five kinds of metrics: M1, percentage of captions that are evaluated as better or equal to human caption; M2, percentage of captions that pass the Turing Test; M3, average correctness of the captions on a scale 1-5 (incorrect -correct); M4, the average amount of detail of the captions on a scale 1-5 (lack of details -very detailed); M5, percentage of captions that are similar to human description.
